environment.description: Lambda function exposed via API Gateway (REST API) with a public endpoint (execute-api). The API Gateway passes through all client-supplied headers including Host, X-Forwarded-For, and X-Cache-Control without modification. No WAF or request validation is configured. Lambda concurrency is set to 1 to maximize cache reuse across invocations sharing the same execution environment. Multiple tenants access the same endpoint differentiated by Host header.
